Title: Allow display .prologue/.epilogue.html even if dotfiles are not displayed

Body:
Hello,

It appears that .prologue/.epilogue.html files are only displayed when dotfiles are ~~not~~ displayed.

Would it be possible to always display the .prologue/.epilogue.html?

It seems according to `README.md` that it should be the default behavior. Although in practice it is not the case.

Thank you

Choices: bug, documentation, feature, question.
